findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_store" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Open a new MyDesigns store for the seller. It is live at its link right away but empty: put products in it with publish_products. It can take orders only once i…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_store_image, publish_products, get_account, upload_designs · Private data: list_store_domains, add_store_domain, check_store_domain, upload_store_image, save_store_image, list_stores, update_store, get_order, list_designs, upload_designs, save_uploaded_design · Public sink: set_store_main_domain, upload_store_image, save_store_image, update_store, create_products, publish_products, get_account, delete_designs, upload_designs, save_uploaded_design · Destructive: remove_store_domain, update_store, deep_search_designs, get_deep_search_results, delete_design_from_card, delete_designs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_store_image, publish_products, get_account, upload_designs · Private data: list_store_domains, add_store_domain, check_store_domain, upload_store_image, save_store_image, list_stores, update_store, get_order, list_designs, upload_designs, save_uploaded_design · Public sink: set_store_main_domain, upload_store_image, save_store_image, update_store, create_products, publish_products, get_account, delete_designs, upload_designs, save_uploaded_design · Destructive: remove_store_domain, update_store, deep_search_designs, get_deep_search_results, delete_design_from_card, delete_designs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
